claims.content: The C2 JU wants to terminate and purge surveillance tracks (Air, Surface (Maritime), Land (Ground), Subsurface, Ballistic Missile, and remote tracks) when a reporting JU ceases reporting or no further updates are received.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The C2 JU wants to terminate and purge surveillance tracks (Air, Surface (Maritime), Land (Ground), Subsurface, Ballistic Missile, and remote tracks) when a reporting JU ceases reporting or no further updates are received.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: A C2 JU terminates and purges an in-scope surveillance track when a reporting JU ceases reporting, relinquishes responsibility, is no longer providing updates, or a specific message is received.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The C2 JU has received surveillance tracks from reporting JUs, and a terminating condition exists: the reporting JU has ceased reporting, relinquished responsibility, stopped updating, or a specific message has been received.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The targeted surveillance tracks are terminated and remote tracks are purged from the system.
in_scope_actions: Terminate and purge Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) tracks when a JU ceases reporting or relinquishes responsibility.
Terminate and purge ballistic missile tracks when a JU ceases reporting or when no further updates are received.
Terminate Subsurface tracks and purge remote tracks when updates cease or specific messages are received.
excluded_adjacent_actions: Terminating EW product information transmission when it is no longer valid or update requirements are not met.
Executing the reporting JU's responsibility-relinquishment process itself.
variant_dimensions: Track category: Air, Surface/Maritime, Land/Ground, Subsurface, Ballistic Missile.
Purge trigger: JU ceased reporting/relinquished responsibility vs no further updates received vs specific message received.
Track source: local vs remote, where remote tracks are purged from the system.

missing_aspects: Evidence for terminating/purging tracks specifically due to 'relinquishing responsibility' or receiving 'specific messages' is not present in the cited cards; the cards only support cessation of reporting or lack of updates.
